cohort: The study included 15 primiparous women with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (TIDM) and 15 non-diabetic primiparous women.
finding: The presence of Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus and higher HbA1c levels were significantly associated with an earlier gestational week of birth and a greater risk of pregnancy or delivery complications.
mod_finding: The odds ratio for Caesarean section was approximately 6 times greater in the TIDM group, and higher HbA1c levels were positively associated with a higher frequency of C-section.
